newsitem.title: UK: Buyers scramble for cover on UK meals market.
newsitem.headline: Buyers scramble for cover on UK meals market.

text.p: Tight nearby supplies of high protein soymeal had buyers running around seeking cover on the UK meals and feeds market on Thursday.
"Nearby supplies of soymeal are very tight and buyers are chasing around trying to get their hands on what is left," said a trader.

Ex-store sellers were not offering any material before second half November with offers at 198.50 stg a tonne while the Seaforth mill was offering October material at 208 stg and first half November at 206 stg.
Traders said shipping delays from the continent were behind the tightness in the market.
"Demand hasn't pickup in the UK. The delay is coming from the mills on the continent who say their supplies of beans are late and are putting back the delivery of fob material," said a trader.
In active trading high protein soymeal on Humberside fetched 197.25 stg for November and 193 stg for December ex-store.
